lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular spots are arranged in a series of near-vertical columns; a specific high-intensity cluster is located at the approximate center-point between the gills and the dorsal fin.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal lines of similar intensity, creating a grid where circular high-luminance blobs are positioned at the intersection nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge is visible along the upper flank, characterized by a sharp transition from high-intensity pixels on the dorsal side to shadow-cast lower intensity on the ventral side.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin displays roughly 15-20 discrete white spots, with a higher concentration found near the base and anterior edge compared to the distal margin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A small notch is present on the mid-posterior edge of the first dorsal fin. An elongated dark object (potential remora) is attached to the lower mid-body near the ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Dense, fine-scale spotting is visible on the dorsal surface of the pectoral fin, contrasting with the larger-scale grid pattern on the flank.
